title: Diagnosis and Fix of Off-By-One Slice Bug
description: Execute failing test suite, diagnose off-by-one boundary failure in paginate(), and fix source file until tests pass.

files.paginator.py:
def paginate(items, page, page_size):
    # Buggy implementation: skips last item
    start = (page - 1) * page_size
    end = start + page_size - 1
    return items[start:end]
files.test_paginator.py:
from paginator import paginate
def test_paginator():
    items = list(range(10))
    res = paginate(items, 1, 5)
    assert len(res) == 5, f'Expected 5, got {len(res)}'
    assert res == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]

input.prompt: Run the tests with `python -m pytest test_paginator.py`. Diagnose the failure and fix paginator.py until tests pass.
